### **Technical Details:**

_**molecule/PDP/BuyBoxStockInfo**_

This component renders a single line of text prefixed by either an icon or an emoji

```
interface BuyBoxStockInfoProps {
  text: string;
  size: 'small' | 'medium' = 'small';
  icon: string;
  style: 'positive' | 'warning' | 'negative' = 'positive';
}
```

* use

    * -`-delivery-and-stock-info-positive-text-color` as positive color
    * `--delivery-and-stock-info-warning-text-color` as warning and 
    * `--delivery-and-stock-info-negative-text-color` as negative
    
* use `LuiIcon` , `LuiText`
summary: A stock and delivery status component displaying availability information with customizable icons, emojis, and semantic color coding for positive, warning, and negative states.
features: Dynamic icon or emoji display with positive, warning, and negative states
Theme-based color variables for semantic status indication
Configurable text with small and medium size variants
Free shipping and delivery time indicators
longDescription:
## Purpose

The Stock Availability and Delivery component communicates product availability and expected delivery timeframes to customers. It uses semantic color coding and visual indicators to help customers quickly understand whether a product can be purchased and when it will arrive.

## Use Cases

- Showing stock availability status and estimated delivery time
- Indicating free shipping eligibility with positive visual feedback
- Warning customers about extended delivery times for backordered items
- Displaying out-of-stock status with clear negative indication

## Design Rationale

The semantic color system (positive/warning/negative) provides immediate visual feedback about availability status without requiring customers to read detailed text. Support for both icons and emojis allows stores to maintain brand personality while conveying important information. Theme-based color variables ensure consistency with the overall store design while maintaining accessibility through sufficient color contrast.
